THE DETAILS

Questions?
We’ve got answers.

What you should know about the current build and where GigBee is headed.

Is GigBee free for freelancers?

The current proposal flow does not require purchasing application credits or tokens. Future commissions or premium features would be disclosed before launch.

Can I join without freelance experience?

Yes. You can create a profile and apply to relevant published projects. Learning and skill assessments are planned for future releases.

Can I hire and freelance on one account?

Yes. GigBee supports freelancer and client roles inside the same account.

Are protected payments and certificates available?

Not yet. These are planned modules, and GigBee does not fabricate completed work or certificates.
